description: This file defines the Websocket API for Zephyr OS, including constants, enums, callback types, data structures, and function prototypes for websocket connection, messaging, and disconnection.

methods.name: websocket_connect
methods.description: Establishes a websocket connection to a server, returning a websocket ID for data transfer.

methods.name: websocket_send_msg
methods.description: Sends a message over an established websocket connection with specified opcode and options.

methods.name: websocket_recv_msg
methods.description: Receives a message from a websocket connection, providing message type and remaining data.
